subject: Marketplace seller onboarding: intake forms, PO routing & go-live timeline
messages:
From: Dana Reyes <dana.reyes@aethonlabs.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@aethonlabs.com
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding + PO path questions

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the intro last week — we’re ready to move forward with Redwood on the AWS Marketplace listing and procurement team asked me to collect the vendor intake paperwork so they can issue a PO. A few quick questions before we submit anything:

- Which vendor name / billing entity should we put on the PO for Marketplace purchases?
- Do you require a W-9 (US) and/or EU VAT form for listings?
- Any specific DocuSign/T&C attachments you expect before finance will sign?

If you can send the intake checklist and a short timeline for activation (once PO is received) that would be great. I’ve attached our standard supplier onboarding form for reference.

Thanks,
Dana Reyes
Procurement Lead
Aethon Labs
attachments: Aethon_Supplier_Form.xlsx

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Reyes <dana.reyes@aethonlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + PO path questions

Hi Dana — great to hear. Quick answers and an intake checklist below. I’m copying Vanessa (Finance) for billing entity + PO routing and Kimberly (Legal) for T&C/DocuSign flow.

Vendor / billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US tax ID available on request). For AWS Marketplace purchases we use the marketplace billing flow for buy-side invoices; however, if your procurement needs a direct PO for platform services (reserved capacity / dedicated) we accept PO to the Redwood legal entity.

Required forms: W-9 (US) for Redwood - we will attach ours. If you’re an EU buyer and require tax invoices we do support EU VAT pass-through; we’ll need your VAT registration number.

DocuSign / T&Cs: Standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) + Marketplace Addendum. Kimberly will confirm whether countersign is needed or if signature via DocuSign is sufficient.

Onboarding checklist (high level):
- Complete Redwood Vendor Intake (attached) [Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.docx]
- Supply buyer-facing billing info + PO number (if required)
- Provide any security evidence required for listing (SOC2_summary attached)
- Legal: review MSA / Marketplace Addendum (DocuSign link to follow)
- Ops: agree go-live date and SKU mapping for marketplace listing

Estimated timeline after we receive completed intake + PO:
- 1 business day: intake and legal triage
- 3-5 business days: finance verification & DocuSign turnaround (if standard)
- 5-10 business days: marketplace listing finalization and go-live (depends on SKU mapping and marketplace queue)

I’ve attached our intake form and SOC2 summary for your team. Vanessa — can you confirm the exact billing address and the payee name we should give Aethon for their PO?

Best,
Chloe Martin
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.docx; SOC2-type2-summary.pdf; Redwood_W9.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Reyes <dana.reyes@aethonlabs.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 13:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + PO path questions

Hi Dana — copying the finance intake details you’ll need to put on the PO.

Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit address: 1400 Market St, Suite 320, San Francisco, CA 94102
Tax ID: 27-1234567 (please confirm in your system)
PO routing: procurement@redwoodinference.com (email) AND please upload the PO into our HubSpot deal (link sent below) so the seller intake team can match it to the listing.

If Aethon is purchasing via AWS Marketplace (credit card/billing through AWS), you do not need to issue a direct PO to Redwood. If you’re contracting for Dedicated capacity or an enterprise commitment that will be invoiced directly, please include the PO number and contact: finance@redwoodinference.com.

EU/VAT: If you want a VAT-pass-through invoice we need your VAT registration number and your invoicing legal entity. We can route EU invoices through our EU subsidiary; flag "EU VAT" in the PO notes and we’ll adjust.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-9821345 (please attach the PO there).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Dana Reyes <dana.reyes@aethonlabs.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2025 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + PO path questions

Thanks Chloe/Vanessa — this is helpful. Two quick follow-ups:

1) We plan to list via AWS Marketplace but our legal team wants to issue a direct PO for the first quarter committed spend (so finance can track the internal budget). I attached our draft PO (Draft_PO_Aethon_1234.pdf). Can you confirm the correct payee + whether we should include the HubSpot deal ID on the PO?

2) AWS Marketplace requires an OEM questionnaire for some listings — do you have a standard marketplace intake the AWS team expects (SKU mapping + contract term placeholders)?

We’ve attached our procurement intake + draft PO. Goal is to have the PO signed next week.

Best,
Dana
attachments: Draft_PO_Aethon_1234.pdf

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Reyes <dana.reyes@aethonlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + PO path questions

Dana — confirmed, thank you for the PO draft. Notes below and next steps: 

- Payee: Redwood Inference, Inc. — please include exact name and our US tax ID on the PO.
- HubSpot deal ID: please include HS-9821345 in the PO notes so Finance can match it during intake.
- Marketplace intake: we have an AWS SKU mapping template and an OEM questionnaire; I’ve added a link to our onboarding drive and a short checklist for the AWS marketplace items. Our Marketplace Program team will reach out separately if any additional vendor attestation is required.

Attachments (for your records): Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.docx, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf.

Next steps / timeline:
- Today: Redwood confirms PO details (done)
- Mon–Wed next week: Finance verifies PO and issues countersign (if required)
- By EOW next week: Ops schedules SKU mapping call and Marketplace intake call
- 5–10 business days after SKU mapping: Listing complete (may vary based on AWS queue)

If you want, I can book a 30-minute intake call Monday morning to walk through the SKU mapping and the OEM questionnaire with your procurement and product teams — what time zone are you in?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf
